card.name: mg after chemotherapy dose numbers
card.fires_on: The unit "mg" right after a large dose number in oncology dosing lines, often before "/m 2" or "every 3 weeks". Also weakly on "on" inside "ritonavir".

modes.label: mg in cancer regimens
modes.description: The unit mg after a number in an infusion dose for a chemotherapy or immunotherapy regimen.
modes.example: in combination with paclitaxel 175<< mg>>/m 2 administered as a 3

modes.label: Inside ritonavir
modes.description: The "on" in the middle of the drug name ritonavir when the label refers to its prescribing information.
modes.example: please refer to ritonavir prescribing information for a description of rit<<on>>avir contraindications.
